# MethodExecutionPlanningRecord Template

This generic template path is retained for compatibility with older links.

The current Layer 3/4 method execution planning template is:

- [Method Execution Planning Record Template v0.7.1](method_execution_planning_record_v0.7.1.md)

`MethodExecutionPlanningRecord v0.7.1` is a small patch over v0.7 and supersedes v0.5 and v0.6 planning language. Older records should be treated as historical or stress-test material unless they are explicitly normalized into the v0.7.1 shape.
